question: How can I adopt a pet through Forever Care?
answer: You can browse available pets in our Shelter & Adoption portal, view detailed profiles (age, breed, temperament, vaccination status), and click 'Apply to Adopt'. Our partnered shelters review applications within 24-48 hours and coordinate meet-and-greets.

question: Are all adoptable pets vaccinated and health-checked?
answer: Yes, 100%! Every pet listed on Forever Care undergoes comprehensive health screening, deworming, microchipping, and core immunizations (Rabies, DHPP for dogs, FVRCP for cats) before placement.

question: How do I book a consultation with one of the specialist doctors?
answer: Navigate to our Veterinarian Portal, search by specialty (Surgery, Cardiology, Dentistry, etc.) or city, select your preferred veterinarian, choose an open time slot, and confirm your appointment with instant SMS/Email reminder confirmation.

question: What if I experience a pet emergency outside clinic hours?
answer: Use our 24/7 Emergency SOS Hotline or AI PetBot triage widget located at the bottom-right corner of any page for immediate first-aid protocols, poison control emergency steps, and direct routing to on-call trauma centers.

question: What payment methods are supported for Pet Store purchases?
answer: We support Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard with 256-bit SSL encryption), Cash on Delivery (COD at your doorstep), and Apple/Google Digital Pay with guaranteed 24-48 hour pet-safe express dispatch.

question: What is your return and satisfaction policy on products?
answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free money-back guarantee on all unopened food, bedding, grooming gear, and pet toys if your companion is not completely satisfied.

question: Can I manage multiple pets and their medical records in my profile?
answer: Yes! In your Pet Owner Dashboard, you can register multiple pets, switch between profiles, track vaccine booster due dates, view veterinary clinical diagnoses, and manage professional spa grooming appointments.

question: How do I share stories or ask questions in the Community hub?
answer: Simply visit the Community page, scroll to 'Share Your Story', fill out the post form with your pet's photo and story, select a category, and click 'Publish Post'. It will appear immediately for fellow pet lovers to read, like, and comment on.

question: Is Forever Care Pets accessible on mobile and tablet devices?
answer: Yes, our web application is built with modern responsive styling, optimized touch controls, dark/light luxury theme switcher, custom paw cursor animations on desktop, and native touch responsiveness on mobile.
